description.zh: 固定在页面顶部的水平导航条：左侧品牌标识，中间主导航链接，右侧搜索、 入口按钮与用户头像。它是网站的"门面导航"，把最重要的三到七个入口压进 一条横向空间，移动端折叠为汉堡菜单。常配合 position: sticky 在滚动时保持可见。
description.en: A horizontal navigation bar pinned to the top of the page: brand on the left, primary links in the middle, search, actions and avatar on the right. It is the front door of a site — the 3–7 most important destinations compressed into one strip, folding into a hamburger menu on mobile. Usually kept visible with position: sticky.

use_when.zh: 入口少而扁平的官网、产品站、文档站
use_when.en: Marketing, product and docs sites with few flat destinations

use_when.zh: 品牌与全局动作需要常驻首屏
use_when.en: Brand and global actions must stay pinned above the fold

use_when.zh: 页面结构上下流动、适合顶部横向空间
use_when.en: Vertically scrolling layouts that can spare one horizontal strip

avoid_when.zh: 层级深、模块多的后台（侧边栏更合适）
avoid_when.en: Deep admin hierarchies — prefer a sidebar

avoid_when.zh: 需要同时扫视大量导航项
avoid_when.en: Scanning many nav items at once

avoid_when.zh: 沉浸式阅读、编辑器等全屏场景

note.en: Brand left, links center, actions right

note.zh: 链接绝对居中，Apple 官网风格
压在首屏大图上，滚动后加底色
note.en: Floats over the hero, gains a background on scroll

notes.zh: 用 sticky 置顶，内部 flex 三段式（品牌 / 链接 / 动作）。当前项用 accent 色或下划线标识（aria-current="page"）。移动端断点下隐藏链接、显示汉堡 按钮，展开为下拉面板或抽屉；透明悬浮变体在滚动超过首屏高度后切换 background 与 backdrop-filter。
notes.en: Sticky top bar with a three-part flex row (brand / links / actions). Mark the current item with accent color or underline (aria-current="page"). Below the mobile breakpoint hide the links behind a hamburger that opens a dropdown or drawer; the overlay variant gains background and backdrop-filter after scrolling past the hero.

basic.zh: 创建一个顶部导航栏组件，包含品牌标识、若干主导航链接、搜索入口和用户头像区。
basic.en: Create a navbar with a brand mark, a few primary links, a search entry and a user area.

design.zh: 创建顶部导航栏：高 56px、sticky 置顶；左侧 Logo + 产品名，中间 4 个导航链接 （当前项用强调色下划线标识），右侧搜索框 + 主按钮 + 头像。移动端折叠为汉堡 按钮并展开为下拉菜单。深浅色主题一致。
design.en: Create a navbar: 56px tall, sticky; logo + product name on the left, four links in the middle (active item marked with an accent underline), search box + primary button + avatar on the right. Folds into a hamburger dropdown on mobile. Consistent in light and dark themes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现 Navbar：header + sticky top-0 + z-index；链接数据驱动， activeId 受控，当前项加 aria-current="page"；sm 断点以下切换汉堡按钮与折叠面板 （max-height 过渡）。提供 gap、theme 变体参数。不引入依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind navbar: header with sticky top-0 and z-index; data-driven links with a controlled activeId and aria-current="page" on the active item; below the sm breakpoint swap to a hamburger with a max-height transition panel. Expose gap and theme props. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现顶部导航栏。

先检查现有路由结构与导航数据来源，复用现有品牌资源与 Design Token。
要求：
- sticky 置顶，含品牌区、导航链接、搜索入口、用户区
- 当前路由高亮（aria-current="page"）
- 移动端折叠为汉堡菜单，展开动画平滑
- 深浅色主题一致
- 不新增不必要的依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a navbar in the current project.

Check the existing routing structure and nav data source first; reuse brand assets and design tokens.
Requirements:
- Sticky top bar with brand, links, search entry and user area
- Active route highlighted (aria-current="page")
- Folds into a hamburger menu on mobile with smooth animation
- Consistent light/dark themes
- No unnecessary dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.

task.zh: 切换导航栏目，展开菜单，搜索资源并体验开始按钮。
task.en: Switch sections, expand navigation, search resources and try the primary action.

checks.zh: 当前栏目与展示内容应对应。
checks.en: The active section should agree with displayed content.

checks.zh: 窄屏下导航仍有可发现的入口。
checks.en: Keep navigation discoverable in narrow layouts.
